verdict.rationale: Cekura's docs describe building custom dashboards with widgets that visualize call data, metrics, and metadata. Its metric system covers the latency and eval-score parts of the story: pre-defined metrics include latency, and custom Python and LLM-judge metrics produce eval scores. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that dashboards can chart cost and error-rate metrics, detail on widget types and aggregation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard feature.
